description: This file declares the IdentityCredential class, which is part of the Android hardware identity module. It defines the interface for managing identity credentials, including methods for creation, deletion, proof of ownership, retrieval, and updating credentials. The class interacts with hardware proxies and manages credential data, namespaces, and cryptographic tokens.

classes.name: IdentityCredential
classes.description: A class implementing the identity credential management interface, providing methods for credential lifecycle operations, cryptographic key management, and secure retrieval processes.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Parses and decrypts the credential data, returning a status code from IIdentityCredentialStore. Must be called immediately after construction.

methods.name: deleteCredential
methods.description: Deletes the credential, returning a proof of deletion signature.

methods.name: deleteCredentialWithChallenge
methods.description: Deletes the credential with a challenge, returning a proof of deletion signature.

methods.name: proveOwnership
methods.description: Generates a proof of ownership signature based on a challenge.

methods.name: createEphemeralKeyPair
methods.description: Creates a temporary key pair for cryptographic operations.

methods.name: setReaderEphemeralPublicKey
methods.description: Sets the reader’s ephemeral public key.

methods.name: setRequestedNamespaces
methods.description: Specifies the namespaces requested for credential retrieval.

methods.name: setVerificationToken
methods.description: Sets the verification token used for credential validation.

methods.name: startRetrieval
methods.description: Begins the process of retrieving credential data with specified access control profiles and cryptographic tokens.

methods.name: startRetrieveEntryValue
methods.description: Starts retrieval of a specific entry value within a namespace.

methods.name: retrieveEntryValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a credential entry, given encrypted content.

methods.name: finishRetrieval
methods.description: Completes the retrieval process, outputting a MAC and device namespaces.

methods.name: generateSigningKeyPair
methods.description: Generates a cryptographic signing key pair and its certificate.

methods.name: updateCredential
methods.description: Updates the credential, providing a writable credential object.
